newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler stock rises after Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler stock rises after Q4 earnings.

text.p: Chrysler Corp's stock rose 1-1/8 to 35-1/4 in early trading Tuesday after the automaker reported fourth quarter operating profits that beat the consensus analyst estimate.

Chrysler reported fully diluted fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.51 before $0.39 in special charges, compared with $1.33 a year ago. Analysts had expected the company to earn $1.43 before special items, according to First Call.
Chrysler recorded total charges of $279 million or $0.39 a share after taxes for early debt retirement, higher United Auto Worker pension costs and other items.
After the charges, the U.S. No. 3 automaker posted fourth quarter net income of $807 million or $1.12 a share. A year ago, the company had net earnings of $1.04 billion or $1.33 a share.
For the full year, Chrysler reported net income of $3.53 billion or $4.74 a share. In all of 1995, Chrysler had net income of $2.03 billion or $2.56 a share.
